definitions.explanation: The act of cutting and gathering mature rice plants from the paddy field. A significant agricultural activity in Japan, typically done in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧{稲刈|いねか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When autumn comes, it's rice harvesting season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稲刈|いねか}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豊作|ほうさく}→豊作：14227_housaku⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This year's rice harvest was bountiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{稲刈|いねか}り⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We had a rice harvesting experience at elementary school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦うちに→うちに：28396_uchini⟧{稲刈|いねか}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}わらせ→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: We have to finish the rice harvesting while the weather is good.

notes:
{稲刈|いねか}り combines ⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧ (rice plant) and ⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧ (cutting).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {稲刈|いねか}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to harvest rice (the する verb is far less common than the noun)
- {稲刈|いねか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ / {稲刈|いねか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧: harvest time / harvest season
- {稲刈|いねか}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧: to help with the rice harvest

SEASON:
Typically takes place in September-October in most of Japan.

- ⟦{豊作|ほうさく}→豊作：14227_housaku⟧: good harvest

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many schools include rice cultivation and harvesting as educational experiences.
